record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare CAMOUFLAGE: Kecleon (3 stars, passive PROTEAN2) and Kecleon Purple (3 stars, no passive); both maxPP 100, range 1, base atk 22 / def 6 / speDef 6. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Heals the caster (flat 15/25/35/70 by stars, times (2 + AP/100); the 3-star Kecleons request 35 x 2 = 70 at 0 AP) and then, if the cast target exists and is not INANIMATE, copies the target: the caster takes the target's index, raises atk, def and speDef to the target's values if those are higher, and takes the target's range (a larger own range first sends the caster to the moving state). The stat copies are plain field assignments, not stat-helper calls.

targeting.who: heal: the caster; copy: the cast target (read only, not changed)
targeting.note: The heal happens regardless of the target; the copy block requires target && target.canBeCopied (passive other than INANIMATE).

geometry.shape: self heal plus single-target copy; no area, no displacement

declaredRaw.label: flat base heal (raw), before the (2 + AP/100) factor

effects.scaling: requested = flatHeal x (2 + AP/100) computed in the strategy (70 at 0 AP for the 3-star Kecleons); handleHeal is called with apBoost 0, so the AP term is NOT applied a second time. In handleHeal: x critPower if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, needs ABILITY_CRIT); x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED; x0.5 while the caster is burning; x0.5 while enraged; x1.2 in ZENITH weather; rounded.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; healReceived = min(applied, missing HP), the remainder is overheal; zero while the caster has the wound status (handleHeal returns 0/0) or protect, or is dead. Burning matters here: a caster burning from another source heals half.

declaredRaw.description: index = target.index; atk/def/speDef = max(own, target's); range = target's range

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit; no clamp except the Math.max on atk, def and speDef.
effects.resolution: only if target exists and passive != INANIMATE. The stat values are read from the target's current fields and written straight into the caster's fields, so Big Eater Belt / Twist Band effects of the stat adders (addAttack etc.) are not involved; the stat is a one-time snapshot (no later link to the target). Range is overwritten even if lower, and when the caster's range was larger it enters the moving state first (skipped for INANIMATE or tree-status casters).

starBehavior.note: Heal base is indexed by the caster's stars; the 1-, 2- and 4-star values (15, 25, 70, also the ?? fallback) are not reachable by these units' bare factory star count. The copy does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: None read in the strategy; which unit is the cast target comes from the generic targeting step.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP (100) of PP and heals again. Repeat casts re-apply the copy using max() against the already raised stats, so stats never go down; the range and index are overwritten each time.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: heal 35 x (2 + AP/100) (70 at 0 AP for the 3-star Kecleons); copy atk/def/speDef = max(own, target). Applied heal = requested x optional crit / BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED / burn / enraged / ZENITH multipliers, rounded, capped at missing HP (the rest is overheal), 0 with wound/protect. Applied stats = the plain max() result (no helper adjustments).
